description:
Build evidence bound to the exact published worker image. This does not prove
that a serving revision has applied the image or loaded a gateway credential.

configDigest.description: OCI configuration digest binding the startup command and filesystem layers.

containerAppGatewayMetadataVersion.description: Authenticated Container App gateway metadata protocol emitted by the runtime.

executableSha256.description: SHA256 of the actual runtime executable in the completed image.

image.description: Registry repository and immutable manifest digest inspected after publishing.
